chapter.verse: Tua lai takin khat leh khat khe kisik kha dongin mi tul tampite a kikhawm uh hi. Zeisu in a nungzuite kiangah a gen masak pen-inah: “Mi simtatna ahi Farisaite’ silngo kikem un la, na tang un.
A kilak lo ding a kisincip bangmah om lo hi. A kithei lo ding a ki-imcip bangmah om lo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin, khuamial sungah na gen khempeuh khuavakna-ah kiza ding hi. Inndei sung leh bil sunga na gen thu in innkhum vumah a kiko ding uh hi.”
“Ka lawmte aw, note kong hilh-inah, pumpi a thah khit cianga bangmah ahih zo lo nate kihta kei un.
Kua mi na kihta ding ci-in kong gen ding hi; pumpi a thah khit ciangin hel khua sungah a khul zo Pa na kihta un. Ahi hi, tua pa na kihta un kong ci hi.
Gitta nga in dangkasan peek nih tawh kizuak hilo ahi hiam? Tuate khat beek Pasian in a mangngilh kei hi.
Na sam uh zong kisim khin hi. Na kihta kei un; note in gitta tampi sangin na manpha zaw uh hi.”
“Ke’n kong cih-inah, mite mai-ah kei hong mang hong ngai khempeuh, Mihing Tapa in Pasian’ vantungmite mai-ah a ngai ding hi.
Mite mai-ah hong nialte Pasian’ vantungmite mai-ah kinial ding hi.
Mihing Tapa a gensiate in maisak nading thu a ngah ding uh hi. Kha Siangtho a gensiate in maisak nading thu a ngah kei ding uh hi.

Amaute in kikhopna inn mai-ah ahi zongin, upate mai-ah ahi zongin, thukhente mai-ah ahi zongin, note hong paipih uh ciangin bangci ka thukkik ding hiam, bang thu ka gen ding hiam ci-in lunghimawh kei un.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, na gen ding uh thu tua hun lai takin, Kha Siangtho in hong hilh ding hi,” ci-in a gen hi.
Mihonpi lakah mi khat in, “Sia aw, ka u in ka pa’ gamh sum hong hop nadingin thu na pia in,” a cih leh,
Zeisu in, “Mipa aw, nomau thukhen ding ahi zongin, sum hawmsak ding ahi zongin kua in kei hong koih hiam?” a ci hi.
Tua zawh ciangin Zeisu in, “Note in huaihamna khempeuh kikemin na tang un. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, mihing nuntakna in sum hauh nading ahi kei hi,” a ci hi.
Thugentehna khat a gen-inah, “Sumhaupa khat in a lo panin an tampi a nei hi.
An teng koih nading om lo ahih ciangin, bang ka ci hih ding hiam ci-in a lungsim sungah a ngaihsun hi.
Hih bangin bawl ning; ka sal ka phel ding a, a lianzaw ka lam ding hi. Tua sal sungah ka an leh ka sum khempeuh ka koih ding hi.
Ka kha kiangah, ‘Kha aw, kum tampi zat ding na tampi a kikhol zo hi. Khawl in la, anne tuidawn, nuamsa-in om in, ka ci ding hi,’ a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Pasian in, ‘Mi haipa aw, tu nitakin na kha a kila ding hi. Na kholsa nate kua in luah ding hiam?’ a ci hi.
Tua mah bangin, ama ading sum a khol hangin, Pasian mai-ah a zawng mi in tua pa tawh kibang ahi hi,” a ci hi.
Khatvei Zeisu in, “Tua ahih ciangin note kiangah kong gen-inah, bang ka ne ding hiam ci-in na nuntak nading uh lunghimawh kei un. Bang ka silh ding hiam ci-in na pumpi ading uh lunghimawh kei un.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, an sangin nuntakna a lianzaw hi. Puan sangin pumpi a lianzaw hi.

Va-akte na lungngai un. Amaute in khaici tuh lo, a at kei uh hi. Beem ahi zongin, saal ahi zongin a nei kei uh hi. Ahih hangin Pasian in tuate a vak hi. Vasate sangin note in bangzahvei a manpha zaw na hi uh hiam?
A lunghihmawh manin na tun san’na uh tong khat bek a khangsak thei note lakah kua a om hiam?
Tua ahih ciangin, a neupen thu nangawn na hih zawh kei uh leh, adangte ading bang hang lunghimawh na hi uh hiam?

Unok kungte in bangci khang thei ahi uh hiam ci-in na lungngai un. Amaute in na lah sem lo, khau lah kheek lo uh hi. Ahih hangin Solomon nangawn in a minthan’na puan a silh lai takin, tua unok khat bangin kizeem lo hi ci-in kong gen hi.
Upna neute aw, tuni-in om a, zing ciangin meikhuk ah kikhul thei lopate Pasian in puan silhsak ahih ciangin, tua tham loin note zong puan hong silhsak ding hilo ahi hiam?
Bang ka ne ding hiam, bang ka dawn ding hiam ci-in na ngaihsun kei un.
Upkhialh lungsim nei kei un. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, leitung mipawlte in hih nate khempeuh a zong uh hi. Note ahih leh, na Pa un tua nate khempeuh na sap uh ahih lam a thei hi.
Ama Gam na zong masa un. Na zon’ uh leh tua nate khempeuh zong hong kipia thuah ding hi.”
“Tuu honno aw, na lau kei un. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, na Pa un note kiangah Gam a hong pia nuam hi.
Na neihsa teng zuak un la, hehpihna na pia un. A lui thei lo dangka-ip na bawl un. Gutate’n naih zo lo a, nget in a suksiat theih lohna vantungah a bei thei lo sum na khol un.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, na sum kholna munah na lungsim uh zong a om ding hi.”
“Note in na kawng uh gak un la, meivak vaksa-in na om un.
A topa in mo la lawm an vakna pan hong ciah a, kong a kiuh ciangin thakhatin ama ading kong hon’ thei ding a lamente tawh kibangin na om un.
Topa hong ciah ciangin, ngakin a om nasemte in thupha a ngah ding uh hi. Ke’n aman takpi kong cih-inah, topa in a kawng gakin tua naseemte an ne dingin tusak a, hong pai-in amaute a vak ding hi.
Zankim lai tak ahi zongin, khuavak dek lai tak ahi zongin, topa hong ciah ciangin tua banga om a muh nasemte in thupha a ngah ding uh hi.
Ahih hangin gutate hong pai ding hun, inn neipa in theikhol leh, ama inn a suksiat loh nadingin a pang ding hi ci-in na thei ta un.
Note in zong kigingkhol un. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, na ngaihsut loh uh hun lai takin, Mihing Tapa a hong pai ding hi,” a ci hi.
Piter in, “Topa aw, hih thugentehna ko bek hong hilh na hi hiam? Ahih kei leh, mi khempeuh na hilh hiam?” ci-in a dong hi.
Topa in, “A topa in a hun a tun’ ciangin, a innkuanpihte’ annek tuidawn a hawmsak dinga a koih, a diktat a lungpil nasempa kua ahi hiam?
A topa hong ciah ciangin, tua banga gamta-a a om a muh nasempa in thupha a ngah ding hi.
Ke’n aman takpi kong cih-inah, ama topa in a sum khempeuh tua nasempa a uksak ding hi.
Ahi zongin tua nasempa in, “Ka topa hong pai hak ding hi,” ci-in a lungsim sungah ngaihsun a, nasem pasalte leh nasem numeite satgawp a, anne tuidawnin, zu kham an khamin;
a lamet loh ni leh a theih loh kalin a topa hong tung ding a, tua nasempa vua-in, a diktat lote tawh a omkhawm sak ding hi.”
“Nasempa in ama topa’ deihna thei napi-in kiging khol lo a, a topa’ deihna bangin na sem kei leh, nakpi satna a thuak ding hi.

A topa’ deihna thei lo a, sat nading a kilawm a gamta nasempa in tawmno satna a thuak ding hi. Hehpihna tampi a ngahte tung panin tampi kingen ding hi. Amaute in mi khatpeuh mah tampi a piak leh, tua mi kiang pan na tampi a ngen kik ding uh hi.”
“Leitungah mei kuangsak dingin hong pai ka hi hi. Tua mei tu-in kihal leh, bang ka deih lai ding hiam?
Ahih hangin, baptaizna khat thuak ding ka nei hi. Tua baptaizna ka thuak matengin ka lungkim lo ding hi.
Leitungah kilemna pia dingin hong pai hi, ci-in na um uh hiam? Ahi kei hi. Kikhenna pia dingin hong pai ka hi hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, tu-a kipanin innkuanpih nga a om sung pan nih pawlkhat, thum pawlkhat in a kikhen ding uh hi.
Pa leh tapa, tapa leh pa, nu leh tanu, tanu leh nu, teeknu leh monu, monu leh teeknu, khat leh khat a kikhen tek ding uh hi,” ci-in thu a hilh hi.
Zeisu in mihonpite kiangah a cihna in, “Note in ni tumna lamah meii kai khat na muh uh ciangin, ‘Guah hong zu ding hi,” thakhatin na ci uh hi. Na cih uh mah bangin ahi thei hi.
Khanglam pan huih hong nung na muh uh ciangin, ‘Ni hong sa ding hi,’ na ci uh hi. Na cih uh mah bangin ahi thei hi.
Mi simtatte aw, note in van leh lei maitang na khen thei uh hi. Tu lai tak hun bang hangin khen thei lo na hi uh hiam?”
“Note in zong bang hangin thu khatpeuh aman hiam, man lo hiam ci-in khen thei lo na hi uh hiam?

Na kitotpih pa tawh thukhen mangpa kiangah na paikhop lai takin, kilem dingin na hahkat in. Tua ahih kei leh, amah in thukhen mangpa kiangah hong kai ding hi. Thukhen mangpa in palikte kiangah hong pia ding a, palikte in thong sungah hong khum ding uh hi.
Na liau ding dangkasan na piak khit matengin, thong sung pan na paikhia thei kei ding hi,” a ci hi.
